text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the cafeteria to have 
lunch...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Should I do it to you too, Trainer? 
Poyo-poyo~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My tummy is all squishy like a steamed 
bun! It feels so nice♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez! That's funny and all, but it won't 
help me become a mature woman!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And besides! I won't even be able to wear 
my racing outfit anymore!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: Time to go on a diet...!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!! After all, it'd be awful if I 
couldn't wear it anymore!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After doing some extra training afterward, 
she somehow managed to work off that soft 
little belly.
